description: Delete one key or array item from a JSON file (later items move down). It must exist. A whole file is not deleted (use remove or trash). Prints "ok FILE#/POINTER". Example: {"path": "cfg.json#/old_key"}. Details: knowledge_read aos/tools/json_del.json.

path.description: FILE#/POINTER in one string, e.g. cfg.json#/states/think/next; FILE alone = the whole document; FILE#/ is the key named "" (RFC 6901). Relative files start at your workspace.
